start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:mark-my-notices-read with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"}, ids [\"told:2\"] and on {\"channel\": \"browser\", \"device_id\": \"browser-a\"}."
no_lists_because: Marking a notice read writes the notice itself in the store the person keeps, in that store's own form; no list of yours holds it, so this workflow names the store and writes only the read state.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:mark-my-notices-read" with store, the ids (or a key), read and on.
3. The first run proves the marks on the example notices: every answer must be the one the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Later marks keep the first surface a notice was read on; a repeated read writes nothing.
